name: Schedule appointment
description: The caller books an appointment on a day and at a time.

gate.question: Is this an appointment call: does the caller want to schedule an appointment?

fields.model_hint: The weekday of the appointment, not a calendar date.
The time of the appointment, with am or pm.

steps.name: Greet and open
steps.description: State the bank name and your own name, then ask how you can help.
steps.example_phrase: Hello, this is Harper Valley National Bank, my name is Jennifer. How can I help you today?
steps.done_when: The agent names the bank and gives their own name, then asks how they can help.

steps.name: Collect day
steps.description: Get the day the caller wants, by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: What day would you like for your appointment?
steps.done_when: The agent has the day from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Collect time
steps.description: Get the time the caller wants, by asking or by confirming.
steps.example_phrase: What time would you like to schedule your appointment?
steps.done_when: The agent has the time from the caller: asked for it, or confirmed it after the caller gave it.

steps.name: Log the appointment
steps.description: Log the task type, the day and the time.

sub_checks.description: The agent logged the task type 'schedule appointment'
The logged day matches what the caller asked
The logged time matches what the caller asked

steps.done_when: The agent logged the right task type, day and time.

steps.name: Confirm appointment
steps.description: Tell the caller the appointment is scheduled, with the day and time.
steps.example_phrase: I've scheduled your appointment for Sunday at nine a.m.

sub_checks.description: The agent said the appointment was scheduled
The day said back matches what the caller asked
The time said back matches what the caller asked

steps.done_when: The agent says the appointment is scheduled and repeats the right day and time.

steps.name: Offer further help
steps.description: Ask whether the caller needs anything else.
steps.example_phrase: Is there anything else I can help you with?
steps.done_when: The agent asks whether the caller needs anything else.

steps.name: Close
steps.description: Thank the caller and end the call.
steps.example_phrase: Thank you for calling, you have a great day.
steps.done_when: The agent thanks the caller or says goodbye before the call ends.
